Some children came to clean the beach, seeing the dumped waste. D. The adjacent industry had dumped the waste, which was floating, into the water, therefore polluting the sea water.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. I was taking a stroll along the beach, when I came across a heap of plastic waste.

B. Realising the importance of removing the waste, I joined them

C. Some children came to clean the beach, seeing the dumped waste.

D. The adjacent industry had dumped the waste, which was floating, into the water, therefore polluting the sea water.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: 'Option 4' that is 'ADCB'.

Key Points

  •  The correct order to make meaningful paragraph is: 'ADCB'.
  • According to the rule of the Rearrangement, the starting sentence should be Introductory.
  • The next sentence should be related to the topic of the first sentence.
  • The next sentence is related to the previous sentence.
  • The last sentence is the concluding sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: 'Option 4'.

Additional Information

  •  The other given options do not follow the rule to make correct and meaningful sequence.

questions.question: Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. The other aspect touches upon certain issues that have arisen in recent years, such as brain-death, mercy killing and cloning. B. There are two major aspects relating to the medical profession and its practice the world over. C. These issues must be discussed and debated in the public domain in terms of our cultures and value systems. D. One of these is the ethics of medical practitioners in their day-to-day relationship with their patients and with one another.
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. The other aspect touches upon certain issues that have arisen in recent years, such as brain-death, mercy killing and cloning.

B. There are two major aspects relating to the medical profession and its practice the world over.

C. These issues must be discussed and debated in the public domain in terms of our cultures and value systems.

D. One of these is the ethics of medical practitioners in their day-to-day relationship with their patients and with one another.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'BDAC.'

Key Points

  • The sentence 'B' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "the two major aspects relating to the medical profession and its practice". Hence, 'B' is the first part.
  • Sentence D will come after B as it is introducing the first aspect out of the two major aspects i.e. the ethics of medical practitioners.
  • Sentence A will come after D as it is talking about the other aspect related to certain issues.
  • The sentence 'C' is the concluding part because it explains that such issues should be discussed in the public domain.
     

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences: There are two major aspects relating to the medical profession and its practice the world over. One of these is the ethics of medical practitioners in their day-to-day relationship with their patients and with one another. The other aspect touches upon certain issues that have arisen in recent years, such as brain-death, mercy killing and cloning. These issues must be discussed and debated in the public domain in terms of our cultures and value systems.

Hint

  • Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles:
    • Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
    • Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
    • Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.
       

Hinglish

  • वाक्य 'B' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "चिकित्सा पेशे और उसके अभ्यास से संबंधित दो प्रमुख पहलुओं" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'B' पहला भाग है।
  • वाक्य D, B के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह दो प्रमुख पहलुओं में से पहला पहलू पेश कर रहा है अर्थात चिकित्सा चिकित्सकों की नैतिकता के बारे में जानकारी दे रहा है।
  • वाक्य A, D के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह कुछ मुद्दों से संबंधित अन्य पहलू के बारे में बात कर रहा है।
  • वाक्य 'C' समापन भाग है क्योंकि यह बताता है कि ऐसे मुद्दों पर सार्वजनिक डोमेन में चर्चा की जानी चाहिए।

questions.question: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order. A. Their prestige and glory spread far and wide. B. The first Olympics were held at Olympia in Greece in 776 B.C. C. It was because the Christians believed that they encouraged pagan worship in temples. D. However, with the advent of Christianity, the games lost their importance.
questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.

A. Their prestige and glory spread far and wide.

B. The first Olympics were held at Olympia in Greece in 776 B.C.

C. It was because the Christians believed that they encouraged pagan worship in temples.

D. However, with the advent of Christianity, the games lost their importance.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 1.

When we connect the sentences to form a paragraph, it is important to establish a connection between them.

  • Sentence B marks the introduction to the paragraph. The subject '1st Olympics were held in 776 B.C. in Greece'.
  • The relative pronoun 'their' in Sentence A connects with B stating that the Olympics glory spread far and wide.
  • A contradiction is seen in Sentence D that with Christianity the games lost their importance.
  • Sentence C is a direct relation with D stating that Christians believed that they encouraged pagan worship in temples.
  • Thus the correct order is BADC.

The first Olympics were held at Olympia in Greece in 776 B.C. Their prestige and glory spread far and wide. However, with the advent of Christianity, the games lost their importance. It was because the Christians believed that they encouraged pagan worship in temples.

A.groups such as migrants and

B.collecting data on vulnerable population

C.persons with disabilities is crucial

D.understanding who are being left behind

E.in identifying the challenges they face and
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'BACED'.

Key Points

  • The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
  • We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
    • The given sentence talks about the importance of collecting data on specific vulnerable population groups like migrants and persons with disabilities.
    • The sequence BACED forms a coherent sentence by first introducing the essential action ("collecting data on vulnerable population groups") in part B.
    • Then, it describes the specific groups involved (part A), emphasizes the crucial nature of this data collection in understanding and supporting these groups (part C), discusses the significance of this data in identifying challenges they face (part E), and finally highlights the purpose of understanding who is being left behind (part D). 
    • This sequence provides a logical flow, starting with the action, introducing the involved groups, emphasizing the importance, discussing the challenges they face, and concluding with the aim of understanding who is left behind.
    • The arrangement follows a logical progression of ideas, ensuring coherence and clarity in expressing the significance of collecting data on vulnerable population groups.
  • Thus, the correct answer is Option 3.
     

Correct Order: Collecting data on vulnerable population groups such as migrants and persons with disabilities is crucial in identifying the challenges they face and understanding who are being left behind.

questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. According to him, Rupees 75 lakhs has been spent to make the gymnasium fully equipped with state-of-the-art fitness machines.

B. The Honorable Commissioner of Police inaugurated the Gymnasium and Swimming pool and appended the management for their efforts in providing such amenities to students.

C. A new indoor gymnasium and swimming pool was inaugurated at APJ International School, Goa.

D. Mr. Mercia, the Principal of the school familiarised the guests about the cost incurred and the various facilities available.
questions.solution:
The correct order is: CBDA.

Key Points

  • The opening sentence should introduce the topic, which in this case is the inauguration of a new facility.
  • Sentence C does this by mentioning the inauguration of the gymnasium and swimming pool.
  • Following the introduction of the event in sentence C, the next logical step is to mention who inaugurated the facility, which is provided in sentence B.
  • Once the event and the dignitary are introduced, the next detail often includes additional information about the event or comments made during it. Sentence D provides this by detailing the Principal's actions during the event.
  • Finally, sentence A gives specific information about the investment made, which is usually mentioned after the formalities of introduction and inauguration are covered.

Therefore, the correct order is: CBDA

Additional Information

  • Starting with costs (A) or facility details (C) is less logical without first introducing the event (B).
  • Sequences that do not start with B (the inauguration) lack a clear and logical introduction.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. Nostalgia helps us maintain a positive psychological status when counteracting the negative impact of difficult situations. B. Nostalgia is a sentimental longing for one's past. C. The adaptive functions of nostalgia are many, with one effect being pain relief. D. It is a self-conscious, perhaps bittersweet but predominantly positive social emotion.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Nostalgia helps us maintain a positive psychological status when counteracting the negative impact of difficult situations.

B. Nostalgia is a sentimental longing for one's past.

C. The adaptive functions of nostalgia are many, with one effect being pain relief.

D. It is a self-conscious, perhaps bittersweet but predominantly positive social emotion.
questions.solution:
The correct order is: BDAC.

Key Points

  • The paragraph should logically progress from defining a concept to explaining its characteristics and then discussing its implications or applications.
  • B provides a clear definition of 'nostalgia,' making it a strong opening sentence
  • D builds upon the definition by adding descriptive qualities to 'nostalgia,' thus following B.
  • A introduces a result or effect of nostalgia, which is a 'positive psychological status,' and it connects well with the description provided in D.
  • C expands on the effects mentioned in A by detailing the 'adaptive functions' and specific effects like 'pain relief,' which gives a more comprehensive understanding of the benefits of nostalgia.

Therefore, the sentences when arranged in the sequence of BDAC form a coherent and logical paragraph, starting with the definition of nostalgia, describing its emotional nuances, and then discussing its positive psychological and adaptive functions.

Additional Information

  • Sequence CDAB doesn't start with a clear definition, and C seems disconnected without first understanding what nostalgia is.
  • Sequence ABDC doesn't provide a logical flow because it discusses the effects of nostalgia before defining it.
  • Sequence CADB puts the cart before the horse by discussing the adaptive functions before even defining what nostalgia is or describing its characteristics.

These kinds of sharks are known as obligate ram ventilators because they draw water in through their mouths and force it out through their gills. B . They use a method called buccal pumping, in which water is pulled in through the mouth and forced out through the gills by the cheek muscles. C . It is true that many types of sharks must keep moving in order to receive life-giving oxygen from the water passing through their gills. D . Other types of sharks are able to remain stationary because they possess special structures called spiracles, which force water out through their gills.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
 
A. These kinds of sharks are known as obligate ram ventilators because they draw water in through their mouths and force it out through their gills.
B. They use a method called buccal pumping, in which water is pulled in through the mouth and forced out through the gills by the cheek muscles.
C. It is true that many types of sharks must keep moving in order to receive life-giving oxygen from the water passing through their gills.
D. Other types of sharks are able to remain stationary because they possess special structures called spiracles, which force water out through their gills.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is CABD.
 

Key Points 

  • Sentence C tells us about the main idea of the paragraph i.e. sharks move in order to receive life-giving oxygen from the water through their gills.
  • Sentence A continues that the sharks that draw water in through their mouth and force it out through their gills are called obligate ram ventilators.
  • Followed by sentence A, sentence B continues as it tells us that process of drawing water in through the mouth and forcing it out through the gills is called Buccal pumping.
  • Sentence D, concludes by telling that other sharks remain stationary as they have spiracles (a special structure to force water out through their gills). 
  • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
 
So the correct passage is- (C) It is true that many types of sharks must keep moving in order to receive life-giving oxygen from the water passing through their gills. (A) These kinds of sharks are known as obligate ram ventilators because they draw water in through their mouths and force it out through their gills. (B) They use a method called buccal pumping, in which water is pulled in through the mouth and forced out through the gills by the cheek muscles. (D) Other types of sharks are able to remain stationary because they possess special structures called spiracles, which force water out through their gills.

Hinglish 

  • वाक्य C हमें पैराग्राफ के मुख्य विचार के बारे में बताता है यानी शार्क अपने गलफड़ों के माध्यम से पानी से जीवनदायिनी ऑक्सीजन प्राप्त करने के लिए चलती हैं।
  • वाक्य A जारी रखता है कि शार्क जो अपने मुंह से पानी खींचती हैं और अपने गलफड़ों के माध्यम से उसे बाहर निकालती हैं, उन्हें ओब्लिगेट रैम वेंटिलेटर कहा जाता है।
  • वाक्य A के बाद वाक्य B जारी है क्योंकि यह हमें बताता है कि मुंह के माध्यम से पानी खींचने और इसे गलफड़ों के माध्यम से बाहर निकालने की प्रक्रिया को बुक्कल पंपिंग कहा जाता है।
  • वाक्य D, यह कहकर समाप्त होता है कि अन्य शार्क स्थिर रहती हैं क्योंकि उनके पास स्पाइरैकल होते हैं (उनके गलफड़ों के माध्यम से पानी को बाहर निकालने के लिए एक विशेष संरचना)।

Directions: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options select the one that gives their correct order.

A. One day, a strange crow from the west, landed on one of the branches.

B. There was a large mango tree deep inside a thick forest.

D. Its branches spread in all directions, lobbing a large shadow on the ground.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'BDCA'. 

Key Points

  • The given sentence is an example of a Sentence Jumble. 
  • The first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, the starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
  • Part B will be the first sentence because it is talking about a past happening. It is talking about a large mango tree in a forest. 
  • Part D will be the second sentence because it further explains that tree. How the tree looks etc. 
  • Part C will be the next sentence because it is connected with Part D. Part D talks about the physical appearance of that tree. And Part D further explains it. 
  • Finally, Part A will be used because Part C starts with 'The Branches' and Part A further explains an incident that 'One day' a crow from the west landed on one of the branches of that mango tree. 
  • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4. 
    ​

Correct Sentence: "There was a large mango tree deep inside a thick forest. Its branches spread in all directions, lobbing a large shadow on the ground. The branches were full of leaves, which crackled when the storm blew. One day, a strange crow from the west, landed on one of the branches."
